unit_cn: Unit 3 Sea Exploration 海洋探索
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 3 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、海洋探索主题(深海探测/蛟龙号/海洋生物/航海史/郑和下西洋/海洋保护)、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Divers found a colourful coral reef on the sea floor.
words.example_cn: 潜水员在海底发现了一片色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁。

words.example_en: The deep-sea dive received wide media coverage around the world.
words.example_cn: 这次深海下潜得到了全世界广泛的新闻报道。

words.meaning_cn: 名录;号码簿;(计算机)目录
words.example_en: Each whale was added to a directory so scientists could track it later.
words.example_cn: 每头鲸都被录入名录,以便科学家日后追踪。

words.example_en: Some people want to exploit the ocean only for its oil and minerals.
words.example_cn: 有些人只想为了石油和矿产而开发海洋。

words.example_en: Deep-sea research has greatly extended our knowledge of marine life.
words.example_cn: 深海研究极大地扩展了我们对海洋生物的了解。

words.example_en: Zheng He led a huge fleet across the sea to many distant lands.
words.example_cn: 郑和率领一支庞大的船队跨海到达许多遥远的国度。

words.example_en: The oil spill released over 200 million gallons of oil into the sea.
words.example_cn: 那次漏油事故向海里排放了超过两亿加仑石油。

words.phrase_en: in a league of its own
words.example_en: As a research vessel, Kexue is in a league of its own.
words.example_cn: 作为一艘科考船,“科学号”可谓独领风骚。

words.meaning_cn: 记录;载入正式记录;日志;原木
words.example_en: Scientists log new species to improve our understanding of ocean life.
words.example_cn: 科学家记录新物种,以增进我们对海洋生命的理解。

words.meaning_cn: 有人控制的;需人操纵的
words.example_en: The Jiaolong is a manned submersible that can dive seven kilometres deep.
words.example_cn: “蛟龙号”是一艘可下潜七千米的载人潜水器。

words.example_en: Plastic pollution is a serious danger to marine life.
words.example_cn: 塑料污染对海洋生物是一个严重的威胁。

words.example_en: Zheng He's voyages are a proud part of China's maritime history.
words.example_cn: 郑和的航行是中国海运史上令人自豪的一部分。

words.example_en: Meanwhile, the researchers noted the location of each group of whales.
words.example_cn: 与此同时,研究人员记下了每群鲸的位置。

words.meaning_cn: 商人;批发商;海上货运的
words.example_en: Along the ancient sea routes, a merchant could trade silk for spices.
words.example_cn: 沿着古老的海上航线,商人可以用丝绸换取香料。

words.example_en: Some countries still hunt these intelligent creatures without mercy.
words.example_cn: 一些国家仍然毫不留情地捕猎这些聪明的生物。

words.example_en: Researchers track whales to plot their long migration path south.
words.example_cn: 研究人员追踪鲸,以绘制它们南下的漫长迁徙路线。

words.example_en: Sailing around the world is a mixture of danger and boredom.
words.example_cn: 环球航行是危险与无聊的混合体。

words.example_en: The writer says some fishermen are "murdering" whales for so-called research.
words.example_cn: 作者说一些渔民正以所谓研究的名义“残害”鲸。

words.example_en: Nations now negotiate to protect the deep sea together.
words.example_cn: 各国如今通过协商来共同保护深海。

words.example_en: Opponents of sea mining warn that it badly damages the ocean floor.
words.example_cn: 反对海底采矿的人警告说,这会严重破坏海底。

words.example_en: Protecting the sea is not only science but also a matter of global politics.
words.example_cn: 保护海洋不仅是科学,也是一个全球政治问题。

words.example_en: The sea is home to life, not human beings' possessions.
words.example_cn: 大海是生命的家园,而不是人类的财产。

words.example_en: Deep-sea exploration has become a respected profession in China.
words.example_cn: 深海探测在中国已成为一项受人尊敬的职业。

words.example_en: In the story, the Sea King's mother was born into the royal family.
words.example_cn: 在故事里,海王的母亲出生于王室。

words.example_en: Early merchants set sail to trade in silk, tea and precious spices.
words.example_cn: 早期商人起航出海,以买卖丝绸、茶叶和珍贵的香料。

words.example_en: A deep-sea submersible can reach places that no diver could ever go.
words.example_cn: 深海潜水器能到达任何潜水员都无法到达的地方。

words.example_en: Sailors used to tell exciting tales of storms and strange sea creatures.
words.example_cn: 水手们过去常讲述关于风暴和奇异海洋生物的精彩故事。

words.example_en: Some experts say we should tax plastic bottles so that people use fewer.
words.example_cn: 一些专家说我们应当对塑料瓶征税,以便人们少用。

words.example_en: The young sailor missed an important sailing tournament because of a storm.
words.example_cn: 那位年轻水手因风暴错过了一场重要的帆船锦标赛。

words.example_en: Special cameras allow scientists to do underwater research in the dark deep.
words.example_cn: 特殊的摄像机让科学家能在黑暗的深海进行水下研究。

words.example_en: Because of injury, the sailor had to withdraw from the long voyage.
words.example_cn: 由于受伤,那名水手不得不退出这次漫长的航行。

words.meaning_cn: 溢出;泼洒;泄漏;泄漏事故
words.example_en: A single oil spill can kill thousands of birds and fish along the coast.
words.example_cn: 一次漏油事故就能杀死沿岸成千上万的鸟和鱼。

words.example_en: Burning fossil fuels makes the sea ice melt faster than before.
words.example_cn: 燃烧化石燃料使海冰比以前融化得更快。

words.example_en: There may be valuable minerals hidden deep under the sea.
words.example_cn: 深海之下可能藏有珍贵的矿物。

words.example_en: Magellan made the first voyage around the whole world.
words.example_cn: 麦哲伦完成了首次环球航行。

words.example_en: Kexue is China's most advanced research vessel on the sea.
words.example_cn: “科学号”是中国海上最先进的科考船。

words.example_en: China has joined other nations on several expeditions to the Arctic.
words.example_cn: 中国已与其他国家一起进行了数次北极考察。

words.example_en: Overfishing has left fewer fish in many parts of the ocean.
words.example_cn: 过度捕捞使海洋许多地方的鱼变少了。

words.example_en: Plastic pollution has even been found in our tap water.
words.example_cn: 塑料污染甚至已在我们的自来水中被发现。

words.example_en: The deep sea may hold vast natural resources for the future.
words.example_cn: 深海可能蕴藏着供未来使用的大量自然资源。

words.example_en: Whales and dolphins are among the most intelligent sea creatures.
words.example_cn: 鲸和海豚是最聪明的海洋生物之一。

words.meaning_cn: 敏感的;脆弱的;善解人意的
words.example_en: The ocean is huge, but it is more sensitive than we think.
words.example_cn: 海洋很大,但它比我们想象的更脆弱。

words.example_en: Although whaling was banned in 1982, some ships still ignore the rule.
words.example_cn: 尽管1982年捕鲸已被禁止,一些船只仍无视这条规定。

words.example_en: The desire to enhance relationships drives China to reach across the sea.
words.example_cn: 增进关系的愿望推动中国跨越海洋伸出友谊之手。

words.example_en: Different marks on their fins help us identify the whales later.
words.example_cn: 鳍上不同的标记帮助我们日后辨认这些鲸。

words.example_en: Scientists track their movements to learn where the whales travel.
words.example_cn: 科学家追踪它们的活动,以了解这些鲸去往何处。
